title: Curated memory front matter
description: <store>/<name>.md, where <store> is <config root>/observational-memory/memories and <name> matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$. The file is not JSON: it is "---\n", one "key: value" line per member below, "---\n", then the body (optional). This schema is of the front matter read as an object of strings (each line split at its first colon, both sides trimmed); list members are comma-separated. A key outside these is kept by v1 and refused by v2's load check (curated.Check). Source: memory/curated/store.go (Memory, format, parse).

project.description: The project root it applies to; absent means everywhere.

sources.description: The sessions that saved or edited it, comma-separated.

retired.description: RFC 3339: when a forget retired it.
